items.text: adult beginner on violin, i want to actually get good at it.

phases.title: Set up and steady basics
phases.focus: Build a comfortable routine, learn instrument setup, and practise relaxed posture, bow hold, and open strings.

phases.title: Develop control
phases.focus: Improve bow control and left-hand placement; connect simple notes and rhythms.

phases.title: Play short pieces
phases.focus: Combine skills in beginner tunes, practise musical phrasing, and finish with a relaxed play-through.

sessionTypes.title: Instrument setup and open strings

blocks.activity: Set up the violin and check a relaxed standing or seated posture.
Practise a comfortable bow hold without playing.
Play open strings with slow, steady bows; pause to reset between strings.
Note one setup or bowing cue to remember next time.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short open-string recording and one written practice cue.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have played each open string with a relaxed hold and steady bow.

sessionTypes.title: Steady bow practice

blocks.activity: Check posture and bow hold.
Draw slow bows on open strings, aiming for an even sound.
Practise short and long bows on two open strings.
Record a short passage and note where the bow felt least steady.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A recording of open-string bowing and one observation about control.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have completed the bow exercises and identified one improvement for next time.

sessionTypes.title: First-finger placement

blocks.activity: Set up comfortably and review open strings.
Place and lift the first finger slowly on one string, keeping the hand relaxed.
Alternate open string and first-finger note with slow bows.
Play a simple two-note rhythm and record one clear attempt.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short recording alternating an open string and first-finger note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can repeat the two-note pattern slowly with relaxed fingers.

sessionTypes.title: Simple rhythms and note changes

blocks.activity: Review posture, bow hold, and open strings.
Clap a simple steady beat, then count aloud.
Play a short pattern using open strings and first-finger notes.
Record the pattern and mark one rhythm or note change to revisit.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A recording of a short counted note pattern.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have played the pattern through at a steady, comfortable pace.

sessionTypes.title: Learn a beginner tune

blocks.activity: Set up and play a few relaxed open-string bows.
Read or listen to a short beginner tune and clap its rhythm.
Practise the tune in small sections, slowly and carefully.
Join the sections and repeat the tune at a comfortable pace.
Record a take and note the next section to improve.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A recording of the tune or its longest connected section.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have played the tune through once, or connected its sections in order.

sessionTypes.title: Review and relaxed play-through

blocks.activity: Set up and review a comfortable posture and bow hold.
Play open strings and a familiar note pattern slowly.
Play a familiar beginner tune or its best-connected sections.
Write down one strength and one next practice target.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A relaxed play-through recording and two brief practice notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have completed the play-through without stopping to correct every small mistake.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.focus: Set up posture, bow hold, and first open-string tone.

phases.title: First Notes
phases.focus: Play simple tunes with steady rhythm and clean string changes.

phases.title: Consolidation
phases.focus: Polish a short piece and perform it from memory.

sessionTypes.title: Setup and Open Strings

blocks.activity: Tune violin and check posture in mirror
Bow hold and open-string long tones
Open-string rhythm: quarter and half notes
Record one open-string bow stroke

sessionTypes.deliverable: A 30-second recording of steady open-string bowing.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can play four slow bows on each open string without scratching.

sessionTypes.title: First Finger Placement

blocks.activity: Warm up with open strings
Place first finger on D and A strings
Play two-note patterns with first finger
Note one spot that felt tense

sessionTypes.deliverable: A written note of one tension spot and one clean two-note pattern.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can place the first finger in tune on two strings.

sessionTypes.title: Simple Tune Practice

blocks.activity: Tune and warm up with open strings
Review first-finger notes
Learn first phrase of a simple tune
Play phrase slowly with metronome

sessionTypes.deliverable: A recording of the first phrase at a slow tempo.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can play the phrase twice in a row without stopping.

sessionTypes.title: Rhythm and Bowing Patterns

blocks.activity: Open-string warm-up
Practice detache and slurred bowing
Apply pattern to a known tune
Clap the rhythm without violin

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short recording of one bowing pattern on a tune.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can keep a steady beat through the pattern.

sessionTypes.title: Listening and Pitch Matching

blocks.activity: Listen to a short beginner violin piece
Match two pitches on the violin
Write down one thing you heard

sessionTypes.deliverable: One written observation about the piece you heard.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can match one pitch by ear.

sessionTypes.title: Review and Polish

blocks.activity: Tune and warm up
Review trouble spots slowly
Play full piece or exercise
Record and listen back

sessionTypes.deliverable: A recording of the full piece or exercise.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can play the piece from start to finish with no stops.

sessionTypes.title: Performance Run-Through

blocks.activity: Tune and warm up
Run the piece once without stopping
Fix one weak spot
Final run-through and record

sessionTypes.deliverable: A final recording of the piece.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can perform the piece once through for a listener.

items.text: Two kids at home, one of them a baby, and I'm itching to keep learning in the scraps of time I get. Not sure what, I just don't want my brain to turn to mush.

phases.title: Core foundations
phases.focus: Review complexity, arrays, strings, and hash maps through short, focused practice.

phases.title: Linear structures
phases.focus: Build fluency with linked lists, stacks, queues, and two-pointer patterns.

phases.title: Search and recursion
phases.focus: Practice binary search, recursion, trees, and systematic problem solving.

phases.title: Graphs and dynamic programming
phases.focus: Apply graph traversal and introductory dynamic programming, then review weak spots.

phases.title: Consolidation
phases.focus: Complete one manageable mixed problem and capture lessons learned.

sessionTypes.title: Concept review

blocks.activity: Recall key ideas from memory.
Study one data structure or algorithm concept.
Write a concise summary with complexity notes.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short concept note with time and space complexity.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can explain the concept and its complexity without looking at notes.

sessionTypes.title: Guided problem practice

blocks.activity: Read the prompt and identify inputs and constraints.
Choose a data structure and outline an approach.
Implement the solution and test examples.
Record complexity and one improvement.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One working solution with tests and complexity notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The solution passes the chosen tests and you can explain its approach.

sessionTypes.title: Independent problem

blocks.activity: Restate the problem and constraints.
Compare possible approaches and select one.
Implement and test the solution independently.
Review edge cases and write a brief reflection.

sessionTypes.deliverable: An independently completed solution and a short reflection.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The solution passes edge-case tests and you can justify the chosen approach.

sessionTypes.title: Pattern drill

blocks.activity: Recall the pattern's recognition cues.
Solve a small targeted exercise.
Note when the pattern applies.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A solved exercise and a pattern-recognition cue.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can identify the pattern and explain why it fits the exercise.

sessionTypes.title: Review and repair

blocks.activity: Choose a recent solution that felt uncertain.
Rework it from memory and check edge cases.
Write the corrected idea and remaining question.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A corrected solution note and one next question.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can reproduce the key steps and identify what changed.

phases.focus: Core data structures and basic algorithm patterns

phases.title: Patterns and Problem Solving
phases.focus: Common algorithm patterns and timed practice

phases.focus: Advanced data structures and mixed review

Implement basic operations
Solve 1-2 easy problems

sessionTypes.deliverable: Working implementation and solved problems
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can explain the structure and solve basic problems

sessionTypes.title: Algorithm Practice

blocks.activity: Review algorithm pattern
Solve 2-3 problems
Review solutions and note patterns

sessionTypes.deliverable: Solved problems with notes
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You solved problems and identified the pattern

sessionTypes.title: Review and Reflect

blocks.activity: Review previous problems
Summarize key takeaways

sessionTypes.deliverable: Summary notes
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have a clear summary of what you learned

sessionTypes.title: Timed Problem Solving

blocks.activity: Warm-up review
Solve 2 problems under time
Analyze mistakes

sessionTypes.deliverable: Timed solutions and error analysis

sessionTypes.deliverable: Reviewed notes
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You refreshed key concepts

items.text: Starting a full-time MBA and I want to keep training seriously for triathlon. Right now I'm doing 16-18 hours a week of swimming, cycling and running. I don't want to end up studying late at night and wrecking my sleep, and I don't want to miss the social side of the program either.

Easy cool-down

Steady endurance run

Easy bike spin

phases.title: Establish a sustainable rhythm
phases.focus: Fit focused triathlon sessions around MBA commitments and protect evenings.

phases.title: Build consistent training

phases.title: Strengthen race-ready routine

sessionTypes.title: Easy aerobic run

blocks.activity: Relaxed warm-up walk and jog.
Run at a conversational effort.
Easy cool-down walk.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short log of duration and perceived effort.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish feeling controlled and able to speak in full sentences.

sessionTypes.title: Steady aerobic ride

blocks.activity: Easy spinning.
Ride steadily at a conversational effort.
Easy spinning to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A ride log with duration and perceived effort.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the ride at an even, conversational effort.

sessionTypes.title: Technique-focused swim

blocks.activity: Easy swim to settle into the water.
Swim relaxed lengths, focusing on smooth breathing and form.
Easy continuous swim.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One technique cue and a brief swim log.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the swim with relaxed, repeatable strokes.

sessionTypes.title: Aerobic bike-to-run brick

blocks.activity: Easy bike warm-up.
Ride steadily at a controlled aerobic effort.
Transition calmly from bike to run.
Run easily, focusing on relaxed form.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brick log with bike and run durations and transition time.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete both legs at controlled effort and record the transition.

sessionTypes.title: Controlled tempo run

blocks.activity: Easy jog warm-up.
Run at a comfortably hard, controlled effort.
Easy jog.
Walk and cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A run log noting tempo duration and perceived effort.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish the tempo segment evenly without sprinting.

sessionTypes.title: Long aerobic ride

blocks.activity: Easy spinning.
Ride at a steady conversational effort.
Easy spinning to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A ride log with total time and perceived effort.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the ride at a steady effort without pushing the final section.

sessionTypes.title: Relaxed recovery swim

blocks.activity: Easy swim.
Swim relaxed lengths with smooth, unhurried strokes.
Easy swim to finish.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brief note on how relaxed the swim felt.

items.text: quiero dejar mi casa ordenada y mantenerla asi. la idea es avanzar cuarto por cuarto en unas 6 semanas y agarrar la costumbre de no volver a acumular.

phases.title: Preparación y primer cuarto
phases.focus: Definir el método, preparar materiales y ordenar el primer cuarto.

phases.title: Avance por zonas
phases.focus: Ordenar cuarto por cuarto y aplicar el sistema de mantenimiento.

phases.title: Cierre y mantenimiento
phases.focus: Terminar los últimos espacios y consolidar el hábito de no acumular.

sessionTypes.title: Planificar método y materiales

blocks.activity: Listar cuartos y prioridades
Definir reglas de orden y descarte
Preparar cajas y etiquetas

sessionTypes.deliverable: Lista de cuartos priorizados y reglas escritas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Tienes la lista y las reglas visibles en un lugar fijo.

sessionTypes.title: Ordenar un cuarto

blocks.activity: Vaciar y agrupar objetos por categoría
Decidir qué se queda, se dona o se tira
Colocar lo que se queda en su sitio
Etiquetar y anotar pendientes

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un cuarto ordenado y una caja de descarte cerrada.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: El cuarto queda despejado y cada objeto tiene un lugar.

sessionTypes.title: Rutina de mantenimiento

blocks.activity: Recoger lo que esté fuera de sitio
Revisar superficies y suelo
Anotar lo que se acumule

sessionTypes.deliverable: Cuarto recogido al final del día.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: No queda nada fuera de su lugar antes de dormir.

sessionTypes.title: Revisión semanal

blocks.activity: Revisar cuartos ya ordenados
Retirar lo acumulado
Planificar el siguiente cuarto

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro de lo mantenido y del próximo objetivo.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Anotas el estado de cada cuarto y el siguiente paso.

sessionTypes.title: Ordenar zona grande

blocks.activity: Preparar cajas y retirar lo ajeno a la zona
Clasificar y decidir qué se queda
Colocar y organizar lo que se queda
Limpiar y revisar el resultado

sessionTypes.deliverable: Zona grande ordenada y funcional.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Puedes usar la zona sin obstáculos y todo tiene un lugar.

sessionTypes.title: Cierre y hábito

blocks.activity: Revisar toda la casa cuarto por cuarto
Corregir lo que se haya desordenado
Escribir el plan de mantenimiento

sessionTypes.deliverable: Casa ordenada y plan de mantenimiento escrito.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Todos los cuartos están en orden y tienes una rutina definida.

phases.title: Preparación y primer espacio
phases.focus: Elegir prioridades y ordenar una zona pequeña.

phases.title: Avance por habitaciones
phases.focus: Ordenar habitaciones por partes y sacar lo que ya no se usa.

phases.title: Completar y consolidar
phases.focus: Terminar las zonas pendientes y establecer rutinas sencillas.

phases.title: Mantenimiento
phases.focus: Repasar una zona y dejar lista una rutina sostenible.

sessionTypes.title: Planificar el orden

blocks.activity: Recorrer la casa y anotar las zonas que necesitan atención.
Elegir una zona pequeña y definir qué significa dejarla ordenada.
Preparar bolsas o cajas para clasificar objetos.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Lista priorizada de zonas y materiales preparados.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La primera zona y el criterio para ordenarla están definidos.

sessionTypes.title: Ordenar una zona

blocks.activity: Despejar la superficie y reunir los objetos de la zona.
Clasificar lo que se queda, se dona, se recicla o se desecha.
Guardar lo que se queda en un lugar claro y accesible.
Retirar las bolsas y dejar la zona lista.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una zona ordenada y objetos clasificados.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La zona cumple el criterio definido y cada objeto que se queda tiene sitio.

sessionTypes.title: Ordenar una habitación

blocks.activity: Elegir un sector de la habitación para empezar.
Clasificar objetos y separar lo que no pertenece a la habitación.
Guardar lo que se queda y despejar las superficies.
Retirar lo que sale y revisar el resultado.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un sector de la habitación ordenado y despejado.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Los objetos tienen un lugar definido y lo que sale está apartado para retirarlo.

sessionTypes.title: Rutina de mantenimiento

blocks.activity: Recoger objetos fuera de lugar.
Devolver cada objeto a su sitio y despejar una superficie.
Anotar una rutina breve para repetir durante la semana.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una zona despejada y una rutina escrita.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La zona queda recogida y la rutina indica cuándo y qué recoger.

sessionTypes.title: Repaso y ajuste

blocks.activity: Revisar las zonas ordenadas y detectar una que necesite atención.
Recoger esa zona y devolver los objetos a su sitio.
Ajustar la rutina de mantenimiento para que sea fácil de repetir.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una zona repasada y una rutina de mantenimiento ajustada.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La zona queda despejada y la rutina tiene un momento concreto para realizarse.

items.text: I want to do a full Ironman for a milestone birthday that's about two years out. Did one before kids and a half last year. These days I work 10-12 hour days and have two small kids, so I can train weekend mornings from 5 to 8 before everyone's up, and maybe some evenings after they're asleep. I'm not taking more time away from the family than that.

items.text: Trabajo a turnos rotativos de mañana, tarde y noche, en bloques de varios días seguidos. En las semanas de mañana o de tarde cumplo casi todos los entrenos y voy a buen ritmo, pero en cuanto me toca noche no rindo nada: hasta el rodaje más tranquilo se me hace cuesta arriba. Después me recupero y vuelta a empezar. Quiero seguir corriendo con un plan que tenga en cuenta la rotación.

items.text: just got a digital piano and i'm a complete beginner. i work 7 to 4 so it's evenings during the week, weekends are more open. want to build a real practice habit and eventually arrange some game music.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.focus: Build a consistent weekday-evening habit and learn keyboard geography, posture, and simple five-finger patterns.

phases.title: Musical Control
phases.focus: Play simple melodies and chord shells with steady rhythm, then begin arranging short game-music phrases.

phases.title: Arranging
phases.focus: Turn game themes into short piano arrangements with melody, bass, and dynamics.

phases.title: Consolidate
phases.focus: Ease off, review the habit, and record one clean arrangement.

sessionTypes.title: Five-Finger Flow

blocks.activity: Sit tall, relax shoulders, place hands in C position.
Play five-finger patterns up and down, hands separately.
Play a simple five-finger melody slowly with steady counting.
Note one thing that felt easier than last time.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A written note of one five-finger pattern and one simple melody played.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Both hands have played the pattern and melody slowly without stopping.

sessionTypes.title: Chord Shells

blocks.activity: Warm up with five-finger patterns in C and G.
Play root and fifth shell chords, left hand only.
Alternate shell chords with a simple right-hand melody note.
Write down the chord shapes used.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A list of shell chords played and one melody note paired with each.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can move between two shell chords without looking at your hands.

sessionTypes.title: Rhythm and Reading

blocks.activity: Clap or tap quarter and half notes.
Read and play a short beginner melody in C.
Repeat the melody with a metronome at a slow tempo.
Mark the measure that was hardest.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short beginner melody played with a steady slow beat.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You played the melody twice with no more than one restart.

sessionTypes.title: Game Theme Sketch

blocks.activity: Choose one short game theme and listen once.
Find the main melody notes by ear, right hand only.
Play the melody slowly and loop the first phrase.
Add one left-hand root note under the phrase.
Record a phone voice memo of the phrase.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A phone recording of the first phrase with melody and one bass note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The phrase is recognizable and played slowly without stopping.

sessionTypes.title: Arrange a Phrase

blocks.activity: Review the game theme phrase from the last session.
Choose two shell chords that fit the phrase.
Play melody in the right hand and shell chords in the left.
Add one dynamic change, soft to slightly louder.
Record the arranged phrase.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A recording of one game-music phrase with melody, chords, and one dynamic change.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The recording has a clear melody, steady beat, and no long pauses.

sessionTypes.title: Weekend Playthrough

blocks.activity: Warm up with five-finger patterns and shell chords.
Play the week's game theme slowly, hands together.
Polish the weakest two measures on repeat.
Play the full phrase or short piece once without stopping.
Record the best full take and note one improvement.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A full recording of the week's phrase or short piece.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You recorded one complete take and wrote one specific next step.

sessionTypes.title: Review and Reset

blocks.activity: Look back at the week's notes and recordings.
Play the piece or phrase you enjoyed most.
Choose one small goal for next week.
Write the goal and the days you will practise.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A written next-week goal and practice days.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The goal is specific and the practice days are on your calendar.

sessionTypes.title: Final Recording

blocks.activity: Warm up gently with five-finger patterns.
Play your arrangement slowly, hands together.
Record two takes and keep the better one.
Listen back and write one thing you are proud of.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One saved recording of your beginner game-music arrangement.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The recording is saved and you wrote one positive note about it.

phases.title: Get comfortable
phases.focus: Set a repeatable routine and explore the keyboard, posture, and simple rhythms.

phases.title: Build basic skills
phases.focus: Practice simple melodies, steady timing, and reading a few notes.

phases.title: Learn a game theme
phases.focus: Choose a short game-music melody and learn it in small sections.

phases.title: Make an arrangement
phases.focus: Shape the melody with simple accompaniment and refine a playable arrangement.

phases.title: Share and reflect
phases.focus: Play a relaxed final take and note what to practice next.

sessionTypes.title: Keyboard warm-up

blocks.activity: Find and name groups of two and three black keys.
Play a comfortable five-note pattern slowly.
Tap a steady beat, then play single notes with it.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short note naming the keys and pattern practiced.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can find the chosen keys and play the pattern three times at an even pace.

sessionTypes.title: Note-reading practice

blocks.activity: Review the note names used in your beginner material.
Read and play a few single-note examples slowly.
Mark one note or symbol to review next time.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A marked page or list of the notes practiced.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can identify and play the selected examples without rushing.

sessionTypes.title: Rhythm and coordination

blocks.activity: Clap or tap a simple, even pulse.
Play a short pattern with one hand while counting steadily.
Repeat the pattern more smoothly, keeping the pulse.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short recording or note describing the rhythm practiced.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the pattern three times while keeping a steady pulse.

sessionTypes.title: Melody practice

blocks.activity: Review the notes and rhythm in a short melody.
Practice one small phrase slowly, hands separately if needed.
Play the phrase from the beginning and note one improvement.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A playable short melody phrase and one practice note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You play the phrase three times with the notes in order and a steady pace.

sessionTypes.title: Learn a game theme section

blocks.activity: Choose a short, beginner-friendly game-music melody and identify its first phrase.
Learn a small section by listening, reading, or following a beginner arrangement.
Play the section slowly and mark any uncertain notes.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A marked score or note list for one learned section.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can play the section through slowly and identify the next spot to work on.

sessionTypes.title: Add simple accompaniment

blocks.activity: Review the melody and choose a simple bass note or chord pattern.
Practice the accompaniment alone at a comfortable pace.
Combine a short melody phrase with the accompaniment, simplifying as needed.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A written accompaniment idea and a short combined passage.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can play the passage slowly without losing your place.

sessionTypes.title: Arrangement rehearsal

blocks.activity: Set a comfortable tempo and review the arrangement's sections.
Practice the hardest transitions in short loops.
Play the arrangement from start to finish and record one take.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A full practice recording and one note about the next refinement.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish a complete take and can name one section to improve.

sessionTypes.title: Final relaxed playthrough

blocks.activity: Review the arrangement and choose a comfortable tempo.
Play the arrangement once, pausing if needed.
Make one relaxed final recording.
Write down one success and one next step.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A final recording and a brief reflection.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have a complete take and a concrete next practice goal.
